name: phoenix-drop
description: Phoenix Drop - One Room. Unlimited Possibilities. Free-first, zero-infrastructure peer-to-peer file sharing platform.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@phoenix-drop/shared && npm run build --workspace=@phoenix-drop/api && npm run build --workspace=@phoenix-drop/web
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=@phoenix-drop/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@phoenix-drop/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@phoenix-drop/web"
